runtime/process#

The native layer under cli/arguments, logging/named, os/command_capture, os/pipeline_capture: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under cli/arguments, logging/named, os/command_capture, os/pipeline_capture: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Shared lazy process capability. Logical strings cross this boundary; each runtime provider performs its own host encoding and process setup.

native process_state_capture#

native async process_state_capture(state is ProcessState, input is @byte, limit is int) is CapturedProcess

Atomically communicates with a started child: writes all input, closes stdin, drains stdout and stderr concurrently, and waits for termination. The limit applies independently to each captured output stream.
